parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: The leg of the pliers is a steel component forming one of the two handles and jaws. It is elongated and slightly curved for ergonomic grip.
parts.Functional_description: It provides leverage and transmits force from the user's hand to the jaws for gripping or cutting objects.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the other leg, enabling the opening and closing motion of the pliers.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the pliers is the central section that includes the pivot joint connecting both legs.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the mechanical hinge that allows the two legs to move in opposition, converting hand motion into gripping force.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but acts as the rotational axis for the two legs during operation.
